exposure: Technical difficulties of epidural analgesia administration
outcome: Failure of epidural analgesia for urgent caesarean delivery
cohort: The study included 502 women undergoing urgent and semi-urgent caesarean sections who had received epidural analgesia at a university hospital.
finding: The incidence of epidural analgesia failure for urgent caesarean delivery was 2.44%, with technical aspects and local anesthetic doses administered identified as related variables.
mod_finding: The study specifically focused on epidural analgesia failure for urgent caesarean delivery, indicating the mode of birth as a caesarean section.
cross-section timing: Data was collected during emergency cesarean sections over 19 months between 2010 and 2011.
gest_age: Gestational age in weeks was an observed variable, though its specific role in the primary finding wasn't detailed in the conclusion.
